name: Will Bradley
original_name: ウィル・ブラッドリー
source:
The protagonist of the story, a young boy who was raised by the eldery people in a remote village. He passed the entrance exam to join The Royal Invitational Institute and aims to graduate to help his village.

He is kind, strong and always willing to help everyone but also naive because is unable to detect people malice behind their words.
